learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire comprehensive knowledge in the core subjects and detailed knowledge in the complementary subjects of the chosen sub-area, and are able to generate new (scientific) solutions within it. The specific learning objectives are agreed upon with the respective coordinator of the specialization.

syllabus_topics: Thermodynamic and kinetic fundamentals of materials science
Structure and properties of wear-resistant materials
Fundamentals of manufacturing processes for ceramics and powder metallurgy
Project Internship Additive Manufacturing: Development and Manufacturing of an Additive Component
Structural Calculation of Fiber Composite Laminates
Failure behavior of engineering materials: Fatigue and Creep
Failure behavior of engineering materials: Deformation and Fracture
Biomechanics: Design in Nature and according to Nature
assessment_rules: Oral examinations last approximately 5 minutes per ECTS credit. The number, form, and scope of assessments may vary based on the individual selection of components.
